commits.message:
Add Todoist integration, post-build script, and e2e tests

- Sync todo widget with Todoist via personal API token
- Dual mode: local tasks or Todoist tasks with seamless toggle
- Natural language due dates in Todoist mode (tomorrow, next monday, etc.)
- Optimistic UI updates with rollback on API failure
- Settings UI for enabling sync and entering API token
- Post-build script auto-syncs dist/ assets into extension/ folder
- Playwright e2e tests for Todoist settings flow
- Added Todoist host permission to manifest
commits.author: DevCSir

commits.message:
Restructure project to modern extension layout

Move all source into src/ with organized component subdirectories
(widgets/, settings/, ui/), consolidate tests into tests/unit/ and
tests/e2e/, move scripts to scripts/, screenshots to docs/.
Replace relative imports with @/ path aliases throughout.
Untrack dist/ build artifacts, remove stale audit.txt and
deprecated ExtensionTutorial component.
commits.author: DevCSir
